name: Agabus
bio: Agabus, a prophet, came from Jerusalem to Antioch and foretold by the Spirit a severe famine that would affect the whole world, which came to pass under Claudius Caesar; the disciples at Antioch responded by sending relief to the believers in Judea through Barnabas and Saul (Acts 11:27-30). His further prophetic role is told in detail in the chapters ahead. Later, at Philip's house in Caesarea, Agabus came down from Judea and dramatically bound his own hands and feet with Paul's belt, prophesying that the Jews at Jerusalem would bind Paul in just this way and hand him over to the Gentiles, moving everyone present to beg Paul not to go up to Jerusalem (Acts 21:10-14).
